name: Tassienet
summary: Tasmanian ISP; began as Tasmania's Access Server ('Tas Access', 1996), listed on ASX as Tassie.net Ltd; brand of Local Telecom and Internet Ltd (with RuralNet); acquired by iiNet ~Jan 2003.

events.details: Tasmania's Access Server (Tas Access) company registered.
Acquired by iiNet (with RuralNet, $2.25M for 15,000 customers).
